articles.title_en: The Agglomeration of Urban Amenities: Evidence from Milan Restaurants
articles.title_cn: 城市便利设施的集聚：来自米兰餐厅的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate agglomeration externalities in Milan’s restaurant sector using the abolition of a unique regulation that restricted where restaurants could locate. In 2005, Milan abolished a minimum distance requirement that had kept the number of establishments artificially constant across neighborhoods. We find that after 2005, the geographical concentration of restaurants increased sharply and at an accelerating rate. Consistent with the existence of strong and self-sustaining agglomeration externalities, restaurants agglomerated in some neighborhoods and deserted others, leading to a growing divergence in local amenities across neighborhoods. Restaurants located in neighborhoods that experienced large increases in agglomeration reacted by increasing product differentiation. (JEL D62, L83, L88, R32, R52)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项限制餐厅选址的独特法规的废除，估计了米兰餐饮业的集聚外部性。2005年，米兰废除了最低距离要求，该要求曾使各街区的餐厅数量人为地保持恒定。我们发现，2005年之后，餐厅的地理集中度急剧上升，并以加速的速度上升。与强大且自我维持的集聚外部性的存在相一致，餐厅在某些街区集聚，而在其他街区则被遗弃，导致各街区本地便利设施的差异不断扩大。位于集聚程度大幅增加街区的餐厅，其反应是增加产品差异化。(JEL D62, L83, L88, R32, R52)

articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a continuous-time reputation model of sovereign debt allowing for both varying levels of partial default and full default. In it, a government can be a nonstrategic commitment type or a strategic opportunistic type, and a government’s reputation is its equilibrium Bayesian posterior of being the commitment type. Our equilibrium has that for bond levels reachable by both types without defaulting, bigger partial defaults (or bigger haircuts for bond holders) imply higher interest rates for subsequent bond issuances, as in the data. (JEL D83, E32, E43, G12, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个主权债务的连续时间声誉模型，允许不同程度的部分违约和完全违约。在该模型中，政府可以是非战略性的承诺类型或战略性的机会主义类型，而政府的声誉是其作为承诺类型的均衡贝叶斯后验概率。我们的均衡表明，对于两种类型在不违约情况下均可达到的债券水平，较大的部分违约（或对债券持有人的较大减记）意味着后续债券发行的利率更高，这与数据相符。（JEL D83, E32, E43, G12, H63）

articles.title_en: Pandemic Schooling Mode and Student Test Scores: Evidence from US School Districts
articles.title_cn: 疫情教学模式与学生考试成绩：来自美国学区的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of district-level schooling mode (in-person versus hybrid or virtual learning) in the 2020–2021 school year on students’ pass rates on standardized tests in grades 3–8 across 11 states. Pass rates declined from 2019 to 2021: an average of 12.8 percentage points in math and 6.8 in English language arts (ELA). Focusing on within-state, within–commuting zone variation in schooling mode, we estimate that districts with full in-person learning had significantly smaller declines (13.4 pp in math, 8.3 in ELA). The value to in-person learning was larger for districts with larger populations of Black students. (JEL H75, I12, I18, I21, I28, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了2020-2021学年学区层面的教学模式（线下教学与混合或线上学习）对11个州3-8年级学生标准化考试通过率的影响。从2019年到2021年，通过率有所下降：数学平均下降12.8个百分点，英语语言艺术（ELA）平均下降6.8个百分点。聚焦于州内和通勤区内的教学模式差异，我们估计，完全线下教学的学区的下降幅度显著更小（数学下降13.4个百分点，ELA下降8.3个百分点）。对于黑人学生比例较大的学区，线下教学的价值更大。（JEL H75, I12, I18, I21, I28, J15）

articles.title_en: Status Quo Property Protection in Politico-Legal Systems
articles.title_cn: 政治法律体系中的现状财产保护
articles.abstract_en: This paper models status quo (SQ) protection of property rights. A politico-legal system determines eligibility of citizen groups for protection. A ruling authority can reallocate property if and only if reallocation is preferable to the status quo for one such group. Along the solution path, SQ protections distort allocations across different assets and different property owners. Asset distortions vanish in the limit as the path converges to a stationary assignment. Ownership distortions vanish in the limit if no individuals belong to every eligible group. If the authority is self-interested, systemic protection of vulnerable groups may be welfare improving. (JEL D72, H13, K11, P14)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对财产权的现状（SQ）保护进行建模。政治法律体系决定公民群体获得保护的资格。当且仅当重新分配对某一此类群体而言优于现状时，统治当局才能重新分配财产。沿着解路径，SQ保护会扭曲不同资产和不同财产所有者之间的配置。当路径收敛至平稳分配时，资产扭曲在极限中消失。如果没有任何个体属于所有合格群体，则所有权扭曲在极限中消失。如果当局是自利的，对弱势群体的系统性保护可能改善福利。（JEL D72, H13, K11, P14）

articles.title_en: Technical Change and Superstar Effects: Evidence from the Rollout of Television
articles.title_cn: 技术变革与超级明星效应：来自电视推广的证据
articles.abstract_en: Technical change that extends market scale can generate winner-take-all dynamics, with large income growth among top earners. I test this “superstar model” in the entertainer labor market, where the historic rollout of television creates a natural experiment in scale-related technological change. The resulting inequality changes are consistent with superstar theory: the launch of a local TV station skews the entertainer wage distribution sharply to the right, with the biggest impact at the very top of the distribution, while negatively impacting workers below the star level. The findings provide evidence of superstar effects and distinguish such effects from popular alternative models. (JEL D31, J31, J44, L82, L88, O33)
articles.abstract_cn: 扩大市场规模的技术变革可以产生赢家通吃的动态，顶尖收入者的收入大幅增长。我在演艺人员劳动力市场中检验了这一“超级明星模型”，其中电视的历史推广创造了与规模相关的技术变革的自然实验。由此产生的收入不平等变化与超级明星理论一致：地方电视台的开播使演艺人员的工资分布急剧右偏，对分布最顶端的影响最大，同时对明星水平以下的工人产生负面影响。这些发现提供了超级明星效应的证据，并将此类效应与流行的替代模型区分开来。(JEL D31, J31, J44, L82, L88, O33)

articles.title_en: National and Global Impacts of Genetically Modified Crops
articles.title_cn: 转基因作物的国家与全球影响
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of genetically modified (GM) crops on countrywide yields, harvested area, and trade using a triple-differences rollout design that exploits variation in the availability of GM seeds across crops, countries, and time. We find positive impacts on yields, especially in poor countries. Our estimates imply that without GM crops, the world would have needed 3.4 percent additional cropland to keep global agricultural output at its 2019 level. We also find that bans on GM cultivation have limited the global gain from GM adoption to one-third of its potential. Poor countries would benefit most from lifting such bans. (JEL O13, Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用三重差分推广设计，通过作物、国家和时间上转基因种子可用性的变化，估计了转基因作物对国家产量、收获面积和贸易的影响。我们发现转基因作物对产量有积极影响，尤其是在贫穷国家。我们的估计表明，如果没有转基因作物，世界将需要额外3.4%的耕地来维持2019年的全球农业产出水平。我们还发现，转基因种植禁令将全球从转基因采用中获得的收益限制在了其潜力的三分之一。贫穷国家将从解除此类禁令中获益最多。（JEL O13, Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18）

articles.title_en: A Note on Temporary Supply Shocks with Aggregate Demand Inertia
articles.title_cn: 关于具有总需求惯性的暂时性供给冲击的注记
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal monetary policy during temporary supply contractions when aggregate demand has inertia and the central bank is concerned about future constraints on expansionary policy. In this environment, it is optimal to run the economy hot until supply recovers. However, the policy does not remain loose throughout the low-supply phase. Overall, when the initial aggregate demand is low, the goal is to frontload the rate cuts to raise demand in anticipation of the recovery of supply. If inflation also has inertia, the central bank still overheats the economy during the low-supply phase but gradually cools it down over time. (JEL E12, E21, E23, E31, E43, E52)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在总需求具有惯性且中央银行担忧未来扩张性政策受限的情况下，暂时性供给收缩期间的最优货币政策。在这种环境下，最优政策是让经济过热运行直至供给恢复。然而，政策在整个低供给阶段并非始终保持宽松。总体而言，当初始总需求较低时，目标是提前降息以提高需求，为供给恢复做准备。如果通胀也具有惯性，中央银行在低供给阶段仍会使经济过热，但会随时间逐渐降温。（JEL E12, E21, E23, E31, E43, E52）

articles.title_en: Should We Tax Capital Income or Wealth?
articles.title_cn: 我们应该对资本收入还是财富征税？
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal capital income and wealth taxation in an economy that reproduces the importance of private businesses for output and inequality. If entrepreneurs are subject to collateral constraints, they face heterogeneous rates of return, which generate a meaningful distinction between capital income and wealth taxation. We find that taxing capital income is preferable to taxing wealth because the efficiency gains from wealth taxation are swamped by the redistributional benefits of taxing the profits of richer entrepreneurs. Consequently, the gains from taxing wealth are modest. This conclusion is robust to the planner’s preference for redistribution and allowing for nonlinear taxes. (JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, K34, L26)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个再现私人企业对产出和不平等重要性的经济中的最优资本收入和财富税。如果企业家面临抵押品约束，他们面临不同的回报率，这产生了资本收入税和财富税之间的有意义区别。我们发现，对资本收入征税优于对财富征税，因为财富税的效率收益被对更富有的企业家的利润征税的再分配收益所淹没。因此，财富税的收益是适度的。这一结论对规划者的再分配偏好和允许非线性税收是稳健的。（JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, K34, L26）

articles.title_en: Influence Motives in Social Signaling: Evidence from COVID-19 Vaccinations in Germany
articles.title_cn: 社会信号中的影响动机：来自德国COVID-19疫苗接种的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether a desire to influence others’ choices affects our own behavior. To separate such influence motives from social pressure, we study participants’ willingness to register for a COVID-19 vaccination in a field experiment in Germany. We vary whether participants’ registration decisions are shared with a peer, to activate social pressure, and whether peers are informed before their own decision, to isolate influence motives. We find that influence motives double participants’ registration likelihood, an effect driven by individuals with ex ante trust in the vaccine. Despite anticipating to influence their peers, participants cannot alter peer behavior in the experiment. (JEL C93, D12, D82, D91, I12, I18)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究影响他人选择的愿望是否会影响我们自己的行为。为了将这种影响动机与社会压力区分开来，我们在德国的一项实地实验中研究了参与者注册COVID-19疫苗接种的意愿。我们变化参与者的注册决定是否与同伴分享，以激活社会压力，以及同伴是否在参与者自己决定之前被告知，以隔离影响动机。我们发现影响动机使参与者的注册可能性翻倍，这一效应由事前信任疫苗的个体驱动。尽管参与者预期会影响同伴，但在实验中他们无法改变同伴的行为。(JEL C93, D12, D82, D91, I12, I18)
